summary: 46 units reviewed word by word. No unit needs retranslation and no identification was found wrong: cirabilva, piṇḍītaka, viśalyā, mahāvṛkṣa, jālinī, suvarcalā, hiraṇyapuṣpī, aparā and kaṭutaila are tagged and hedged acceptably. Fixes: over-enrichment of a damaged word (57), two silent emendations without flags (52, 82), a wrong flag reason (70) and a flag text contradicting `words` (87), supplied words in English/Hindi (74, 88, 90, 60, 64), a dropped hi in Hindi (56), missing identification beside lāṅgalī/śāli (91, 87), 'such as' in 92, curādi verbs mislabelled causative (58, 83), and cross-unit continuation notes (80, 83-87, 91, 92). Human decisions left open: 47 cyanya, 53 āḍhyaḥ and the gerundive+accusative, 57 trāryā/muśalyāyāma, 60 and 70 conjectures (confidence), 69 genitive apām, 85 stray ca, 87 kaṭukālābu one drug vs two. Copula supplied in 51/55/73/74 is within the glossary's 'copula understood' practice (74 loses the extra 'and leads to'). Regrouping: none required; 51+52 (heading plus sign), 62-65 and 67-68 (mantra), 75+76, 79-81 and 82-92 (remedy lists) are noted as continuations only.
glossary_suggestions: curādi verbs (pīḍayet, ākuṭṭayet, bhakṣayet) take gram '(10th class)', not 'caus.'; dhūpayet label left as is.
aparā = placenta (अपरा यानी जेर), standard; yoni = vagina/birth passage, standard; vedanā in labour contexts = labour pain (probable); garbha-saṅga = retained/obstructed fetus (probable).
pravāhaṇa / pra-√vah = 'bearing down' (English), Hindi प्रवाहण with जोर लगाना, no added 'downward'.

Identifications used in ch03 k2: cirabilva = Holoptelea integrifolia / चिलबिल (probable); piṇḍītaka = Randia dumetorum / मैनफल (probable); viśalyā = lāṅgalī (probable); suvarcalā disputed; jālinī a Luffa, तोरई hedged (disputed); mahāvṛkṣa probably snuhī / थूहर (disputed); hiraṇyapuṣpī unidentified; kaṭutaila probably mustard oil.
kāca-maṇi stays literal 'glass-gem' (sense doubtful); a damaged word's conjectured meaning goes only to the text_flag and notes, never into the gloss or translation (e.g. 57 muśalyāyāma).
A silent emendation in `words` (e.g. avagṛṇhāti→avagṛhṇāti, upariṣṭhāt→upariṣṭāt, alāmbu→alābu) needs a text_flag; do not call a misprint an 'attested variant' without evidence.
Do not supply 'she' for an unstated subject of an optative when the actor may differ (use 'one'); 'such as' is banned even inside identification parentheses.
